themes.source: src/pages/index.astro global style (:root and :root[data-theme=dark]); docs pages use src/styles/tokens.css (docs-* tokens); both store the theme under localStorage starlight-theme

shadows.name: keycap
shadows.purpose: The Esc keycap at rest: its lip and a soft drop.

shadows.name: keycap-down
shadows.purpose: The keycap pressed or after a stop.

shadows.name: play-over-still
shadows.purpose: The Play button laid over the recording still.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All UI transitions and the diagram animations.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 10% entry 70%
motion.purpose: Each section rule draws across as the section scrolls in.

motion.name: diagram-sweep
motion.value: cover scaleX(1 - t/duration), labels opacity 0 and translateY(5px) until seen (280ms, 380ms), pens on the traces
motion.purpose: The timing diagram draws in step with the recording.

motion.name: key-ask
motion.value: ask 1.6s ease infinite: ring opacity 0.7 to 0, scale 0.92 to 1.18
motion.purpose: The keycap invites a press while the agent works.

motion.name: key-press
motion.value: translateY(3px) and the short shadow, 90ms ease
motion.purpose: The keycap sinks when pressed or when a stop lands.

motion.name: stop-flash
motion.value: flash 750ms ease: red overlay opacity 0.28 to 0
motion.purpose: The diagram flashes when a stop lands.

motion.name: headline-stroke
motion.purpose: The highlighter stroke under the headline stop line when a stop lands.

motion.name: packet
motion.value: 260ms per hop, linear; refused check shakes 420ms ease-out
motion.purpose: An action travelling through the checks.

motion.name: field-sequence
motion.value: one field every 1300ms once 60% in view, until the reader points
motion.purpose: Result fields highlight their lines in turn.

motion.name: stop-fades
motion.purpose: What later calls become after a stop.

motion.name: button-press
motion.value: scale(0.97) Install, scale(0.96) Copy and Play, 140ms ease

motion.name: theme-icon
motion.purpose: The theme icon in the dark theme.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No rule draw, sweep, packet, shake, flash, ring, field sequence, smooth scroll or crossfade; recordings wait for Play; diagrams appear complete.

breakpoints.name: gates-upright
breakpoints.purpose: The block diagram stands upright; Table 1 stacks.

breakpoints.name: one-column
breakpoints.purpose: Running head hides; section heads and limits go to one column.

breakpoints.name: stage-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Recording, prompt and keycap stack; Result goes to one column.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: Docs anchors and copy buttons grow to 2.75rem.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Datasheet"**

The home page reads like a component datasheet: a running head across the top, ruled sections, one numbered figure (Figure 1, the recorded sessions as timing diagrams) and one numbered table (Table 1, when an action is refused), then the install steps. Paper and ink carry everything. Rules do the work that panels and cards would do elsewhere: a 2px ink rule opens each section, 1px ink rules head tables and lists, and 1px light rules separate rows.

Colour has two jobs and no decorative ones. The highlighter (mark, mark-strong) shows what is held or pointed at: the stretch where the agent holds the lease, the call under the cursor, the answer lines a field explains, the table row being run, the action travelling through the checks. Red is the stop key, the stop line of the headline, and every refused, cut or stopped answer.

The home page (`src/pages/index.astro`) sits outside Starlight and defines its own palette in a global style block, light and dark. The docs pages are Starlight restyled by `src/styles/theme.css` and keep the older concrete palette from `src/styles/tokens.css` (the docs-* tokens). The two palettes are separate. Both kinds of page share Archivo, JetBrains Mono, the theme stored under `starlight-theme`, and the crossfade between pages.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink and rules; no panels, cards or section backgrounds.
A yellow highlighter for state and attention, never for decoration.
One red, for the stop key and refused answers.
Archivo for text; JetBrains Mono for calls, commands, answers and the numbers that go with them (times, version).
Numbered figure and table captions in the datasheet manner.
Motion only where it explains, all of it off under reduced motion, and every part readable without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks state or attention: held, current, running, pointed at. If nothing is held or pointed at, nothing is yellow.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the stop key and the answers it causes (refused, cut, stopped, taken back). Never use red for links, emphasis or calls to action.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: A figure or table that carries evidence is captioned with its number in bold ink ("Figure 1.", "Table 1.") followed by the caption in second ink.

rules.name: The Mono for Machines Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for calls, commands, answers and the numbers attached to them. Headings, labels and prose stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Rule Not Panel Rule
rules.body: Separate content with rules (2px ink to open a section, 1px ink to head a table or list, 1px rule between rows), not with background panels or shadows.

dos: **Do** caption evidence as numbered figures and tables, with the number in bold ink.
**Do** use the highlighter only for what is held, current, running or pointed at.
**Do** keep red for the stop key and the answers it causes, with on-red text on it.
**Do** separate sections and rows with rules: 2px ink to open, 1px ink to head, 1px rule between.
**Do** draw diagrams at build time so they read complete without JavaScript, and give every interactive part a no-JS state.
**Do** tie each motion to what it explains, and give it a complete reduced-motion state.
**Do** keep the docs pages on the `tokens.css` palette and the home page on its own; change either on purpose, not by drift.
donts: **Don't** add card panels, background bands or decorative shadows; the keycap and the Play button over the still are the only shadows.
**Don't** use yellow or red as decoration, emphasis or link colour.
**Don't** set headings, prose or labels in JetBrains Mono.
**Don't** put a small uppercase label above a heading; uppercase labels name lanes, columns and lists.
**Don't** show a recording without its calls as text.
